scope: self-judgment of the six v3 videos against first-party data, platform statements and frame measurements
actions_taken: read-only research; nothing posted, scheduled, uploaded or changed; vidIQ credits used: 40 (1,741 -> 1,701); ElevenLabs history audio downloaded for pace measurement (no generation)

first_party_findings.finding: IG reels are pass/fail: 4 of 12 reached 1,941-2,692 plays, 8 stalled at 133-268, nothing between
All 6 pushed reels (Jun 30-Aug 30) had 3-second skip <= 41.2%; none of 18 above it were pushed (p~0.0006 under random push)
'This ___ did ___' opener: 8/12 reels, 2 pushed, median 246; other openers 2/4 pushed, median 1,338
Body at risk: IG 3/4 pushed vs 1/8 others; YT 4/4 breakouts; FB 3/3 breakouts
first_party_findings.note: post-hoc, non-blind topic coding; IG p~0.07

first_party_findings.finding: Full-frame + body at risk 4/5 broke out on YT; banded + body at risk 0/5 (median 2,204)
Breakouts lost 32.8-39.6% by ~6 s; stalled full-frame lost 40.1-41.5%; banded 28.4-41.2%; YT cliff at 4.1-4.3 s
Mars reel (2.2 s real NASA footage, then 66% Curio 2D animation) was top-2; no all-animation reel has been posted
Pace is not a concern: pushed 138-208 WPM; trycurio Zack takes 163-208 WPM (median ~185); v3 184-198
Posting after Oct 19: nothing; last YT Short Oct 9 (11 days silent)

platform_evidence.claim: Top IG ranking signals: watch time, likes, sends (sends slightly more for non-followers)
IG shows less of Reels that are low-res, watermarked, muted, contain borders or are mostly text
Borders, watermarks, subtitles or credits do not make reposted content original; narration that re-contextualizes does
Skip rate = share of views skipped in the first 3 s; 'the first three seconds of a reel are super important'
platform_evidence.source: Meta Graph API Instagram media insights docs; https://www.instagram.com/reel/DA0ua3-yuDg

platform_evidence.claim: Reels safe zone (ads spec): top 14%, bottom 35%, 6% each side clear -> at 1080x1920 keep key content within y 269-1248, x 65-1015
Over 75% of Reels views are sound-on
IG lists a reel narrated with a realistic AI-generated voiceover as content to label AI info
platform_evidence.note: confirmed via search-index text, not a direct page read

platform_evidence.claim: YT Shorts judged on viewed vs swiped away; no favored length
Since 2025-03-31 a Shorts view counts every start/replay; engaged views keep the old definition
YT disclosure not required for animation; required for realistic altered depictions of real people/events
Length studies conflict: quso.ai (108k Shorts) favors 11-20 s; Socialinsider (9.77M brand Reels) favors 45-60 s
Loops: no platform says they boost ranking; replays count toward IG watch time

measurement_method.motion: ffmpeg scdet scene score per frame at 30 fps on the 1080x1080 strip (downscaled 270x270), averaged per second; <0.35 = near-still second
measurement_method.loop: SSIM of first vs last strip frame
measurement_method.captions: replica of kit autoLines/styleCaptions chunking, chunk display time = next chunk start - this start
measurement_method.safe_zone: element y positions from scene code (bandMap) mapped to screen coordinates

P2.safe_zone_issue: date line on note at y~1250

P5.safe_zone_issue: TUC bar and 'this video' marker at y~1288-1390 (below 1248)

pass_chance_note: inference from small samples (n=12 IG, 17 YT); not a forecast
recommendations_ranked: ~2 s rights-clear real opener then animation
visible change every ~2 s, esp. 3-6 s
swap/reframe P4 and P6 toward body-at-risk (spare: Siffre)
owner decisions: full-frame cut of P1+P3; AI-info label
